tools.description: Create a new branch in a GitHub repository. Requires the SHA of the commit to branch from (typically the HEAD of main).
tools.name: github_branch_create

tools.description: Get details of a specific branch in a GitHub repository. Returns the branch name, latest commit SHA, and protection status.
tools.name: github_branch_get

tools.description: List all branches in a GitHub repository. Returns branch names, commit SHAs, and protection status. Supports pagination.
tools.name: github_branches_list

tools.description: Get the contents of a file or directory from a GitHub repository. Returns Base64 encoded content for files.
tools.name: github_file_contents_get

tools.description: Create a new file or update an existing file in a GitHub repository. Content must be Base64 encoded. Requires SHA when updating existing files.
tools.name: github_file_create_update

tools.description: Create a new issue in a repository. Requires push access to set assignees, milestones, and labels.
tools.name: github_issue_create

tools.description: List issues in a repository. Both issues and pull requests are returned as issues in the GitHub API.
tools.name: github_issues_list

tools.description: List public repositories for a specified user. Does not require authentication.
tools.name: github_public_repos_list

tools.description: Create a new pull request in a repository. Requires write access to the head branch.
tools.name: github_pull_request_create

tools.description: List pull requests in a repository with optional filtering by state, head, and base branches.
tools.name: github_pull_requests_list

tools.description: Get detailed information about a GitHub repository including metadata, settings, and statistics.
tools.name: github_repo_get

tools.description: List repositories for the authenticated user. Requires authentication.
tools.name: github_user_repos_list
